name: privacyscrubber/pii-masking-mcp
description: CISO-Approved Zero-Trust PII & Secrets Redaction MCP Server for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop. Prevent API leaks and comply with HIPAA/SOC 2 locally.

tools.name: sanitize_text
tools.description: Locally scrubs PII, secrets, and credentials (like API keys, passwords, emails, phones, names) from code, logs, or text. Replaces them with safe placeholders (e.g., [EMAIL_1], [API_KEY_1]). Keep your data secure before passing it to any LLM.

tools.name: reveal_text
tools.description: Replaces masked tokens (e.g., [EMAIL_1], [API_KEY_1]) in the LLM's response back with the original private data from the local volatile RAM-only session map.

tools.name: sanitize_file
tools.description: Reads a local file, sanitizes its contents using the selected profile, and outputs the safe version for AI analysis. Securely keeps original identifiers in memory.

tools.name: audit_directory_for_pii
tools.description: Audits a local directory or project tree for PII, secrets, and compliance vulnerabilities without sending data to any external server.

tools.name: generate_compliance_report
tools.description: Generates a structured compliance report (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS) and enterprise CISO audit receipt for the current session or workspace.

tools.name: export_audit_log
tools.description: Exports a zero-knowledge immutable audit receipt verifying zero-egress data sanitization for compliance documentation.

tools.name: guard_exec
tools.description: Sanitizes command line execution strings and arguments for autonomous AI agents prior to tool dispatch.

tools.name: generate_procurement_memo
tools.description: Generates a comprehensive CISO/DPO enterprise procurement memo and ROI business case for PrivacyScrubber TEAMS/SDK licensing.

PRIVACYSCRUBBER_KEY.title: PrivacyScrubber License Key
PRIVACYSCRUBBER_KEY.description: Optional PRO or TEAMS license key. Leave blank to use the Free tier.
